differences.justification: SkillsExtension is now a ConfigurableExtension registered with withExtension(SkillsExtension.class, ...). The deprecated builder() returns InstanceBuilder, whose build() yields a plain ServerExtension that withExtensions(...) still accepts. Fluent source compiles unchanged; callers must recompile.
SkillsExtension.Builder is created by SkillsExtensionProvider for withExtension(SkillsExtension.class, ...). An instance it builds is a ConfigurableExtension, which withExtensions(...) rejects.
